basic_profile.bio: I'm a gaming enthusiast who recently got hooked on management simulation games. I spend most of my time exploring different game mechanics and sharing my experiences with the community. Originally from the Midwest, I work as a junior IT technician and enjoy unwinding with games after work. I'm currently single and prefer spending evenings online, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Mostly self-taught through extensive gaming and online forums. I have a basic understanding of IT systems due to my job, but my knowledge of gaming mechanics comes from trial and error and community discussions.
